plan.scope: Oracle diagnostic only; no candidate method can use Joint weights or predictions. All16 full exposed validation and original calibration, FP32, no fitting or checkpoint selection, no official-test reads/inference.

partitions.tower_qformer: All active parameters partition into tower and qformer. Use both marginal swaps and their full factorial interaction.
partitions.tokenizer_rest: All tokenizer parameters versus all other active parameters.
partitions.spatial_rest: Only spatial convolution weight/bias versus all other active parameters.

plan.interpretation: Measure which swaps recover the current4.1466pp validation gap and whether complementarity is necessary. A swap failure is not evidence the component is irrelevant: components can be co-adapted. These interventions are not achievable-method scores or accuracy upper bounds.
plan.motivation: A spatial-nullspace hypothesis targets one small component. Locate empirical Joint-gap sensitivity across three predeclared architecture partitions before choosing more elaborate interventions. Prior component swaps compared base and older mergers; this diagnostic uses current FP32 merger versus Joint.
